headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 1, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings and allowing no earned runs. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested game, while the Baltimore Orioles took down the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Minnesota Twins right-handed pitcher Mike Paredes, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. Other players on the injured list include Brock Stewart of the Los Angeles Dodgers, Matt Vierling of the Detroit Tigers, J.P. Crawford of the Seattle Mariners, Cionel Pérez of the New York Mets, Shane McClanahan of the Tampa Bay Rays, Gavin Hollowell of the Chicago Cubs, and Cole Sands of the Minnesota Twins.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their bullpen with a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Codi Heuer and catcher Bo Naylor from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for outfielder Blake Perkins and right-handed pitcher Craig Yoho. The Baltimore Orioles also made a trade, sending right-handed pitcher Dean Kremer to the Minnesota Twins in exchange for outfielder Jhomnardo Reyes.

top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested game. Sal Stewart led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall to Orioles in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4, securing a crucial win. Pete Alonso led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Andrew Painter pitched 6 strong innings for the Phillies.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the St. Louis Cardinals 3-1, securing a crucial win. Luis Urías led the Cardinals' offense with a single, 2 RBI, and 1 AB.

top_news.title: **Twins RHP Mike Paredes Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins right-handed pitcher Mike Paredes has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Bullpen with Trade**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have acquired right-handed pitcher Codi Heuer and catcher Bo Naylor from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for outfielder Blake Perkins and right-handed pitcher Craig Yoho.
